title: Blender animation basics
line: Keyframes, easing and a bouncing ball, rendered to video.

project.title: A rocket launch shot
project.brief: Animate a short rocket launch on your own. A rocket with parented fins lifts off slowly, speeds up and leaves the frame while the camera turns to follow. Render it to video.
checks: The fins are children of the rocket body and only the body is keyed
The rocket's Z curve starts flat and gets steeper over time
A video of at least 72 frames is saved

lessons.title: Your first keyframes
lessons.goal: Teach keyframes in Blender by sliding a cube from X 0 to X 5. Insert Location keyframes with I at frame 1 and at frame 48, then play it back with Space.
lessons.passes: The cube has Location keyframes at frames 1 and 48 and sits at X 5 on frame 48.

lessons.title: The timeline and frame rate
lessons.goal: Teach Blender's Timeline. Set the frame rate to 24 fps and the end frame to 72, scrub, jump between keyframes and move the last key so the slide takes 3 seconds.
lessons.passes: The scene runs at 24 fps, ends at frame 72 and the cube's last key is at frame 72.

lessons.title: Linear, Bezier and Constant
lessons.goal: Teach keyframe interpolation modes in Blender with T by making a clock with a minute hand that ticks in steps using Constant keys and a second hand that sweeps using Linear keys.
lessons.passes: One hand's rotation keys are Constant and the other hand's are Linear.

lessons.title: Shape motion in the Graph Editor
lessons.goal: Teach Blender's Graph Editor by opening the cube's X Location curve and moving the keyframe handles so the cube starts slowly and overshoots a little before it settles.
lessons.passes: The X Location curve has edited handles and rises above its final value.

lessons.title: Parent one object to another
lessons.goal: Teach parenting in Blender with Ctrl P by building a simple desk fan with three blades parented to a hub, then keying only the hub so the blades spin with it.
lessons.passes: The blades are children of the hub and only the hub has rotation keyframes.

lessons.title: A bouncing ball
lessons.goal: Teach timing and spacing in Blender by animating a ball from frame 1 to frame 49 that drops and bounces three times, each bounce lower, with sharp turns at the floor in the Graph Editor.
lessons.passes: The ball's Z curve touches the floor three times and each peak is lower than the last.

lessons.title: Retime it in the Dope Sheet
lessons.goal: Teach Blender's Dope Sheet by selecting all of the ball's keyframes and scaling them so the bounce takes twice as long, then sliding single keys to fix the rhythm.
lessons.passes: The ball's keyframes span 96 frames, twice the 48 they spanned before.

lessons.title: Move the camera
lessons.goal: Teach camera animation in Blender by keying a slow push in toward the ball and adding a Track To constraint aimed at an empty so the shot stays framed.
lessons.passes: The camera has Location keyframes and a Track To constraint aimed at an empty.

lessons.title: Render the animation to a video
lessons.goal: Teach rendering an animation in Blender. Set the frame range to 1 to 96, set the output to an MP4 video with H.264, pick a folder and run Render Animation.
lessons.passes: An MP4 file of 96 frames at 24 fps is saved.
